statement: Create new content in attributes and geometry data with "Add Attribute"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Run the data operation "Convert Attribute" on the current selection in attributes and geometry data; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.

Remove or clear content in attributes and geometry data with "Remove Attribute"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in attributes and geometry data with "Add Color Attribute"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Run the data operation "Convert Color Attribute" on the current selection in attributes and geometry data; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.
Copy content in attributes and geometry data with "Duplicate Color Attribute"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.

Remove or clear content in attributes and geometry data with "Remove Color Attribute"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in attributes and geometry data with "Set Render Color"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in attributes and geometry data with "Set Geometry Randomization"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
